deferred_work.reason: Explicitly deferred by user while parent-system legacy closure is completed; not a parent-core defect.

host_hardening.note: Public outsiders do not receive repository write permission by default, but main is not protected against authorized writers/owner-level mistakes. Current connector exposes read but not ruleset/protection administration.
Raw connector calls are outside Python ActionCoordinator interception; UAOS policy and CAS govern intended use, while physical credential/ruleset enforcement belongs to the host/repository layer.

known_limitations: same-model self-critique, refinement or debate is candidate-generation evidence and is not independent verification by itself
S3 CI evidence uses a standalone HTTP protocol emulator and does not certify any eventual production bucket/provider configuration
live OpenAI provider evidence is optional/manual and was not rerun because provider integration code was unchanged in this parent-core maintenance release
child parent-upcall and parent-governed descendant E2E evidence is deferred by scope rather than claimed complete
readiness_semantics: Parent controller core has no known internally reproducible blocker after full repository CI, PostgreSQL/DBOS live verification, crash/recovery verification and S3 protocol roundtrip. This is not a claim that every future child/provider integration is complete or that host-level GitHub protection is enabled.
